status_as_of_cutoff: partial live / site work-construction: Oracle says AI workloads were live by January 2026; TDLR records support buildings 1-8 work, while City/County abatement records and Crusoe's March 2026 announcement support an adjacent phase 9-10/power-plant expansion still projected for later energization.

status_history.status: First-phase and additional buildings are supported by TDLR/TCEQ and local tax records; the complete building-by-building permit, energization, and service record was not assembled.

evidence_grade: A-/B+: official TDLR, City of Abilene, Taylor County, TCEQ, and Oracle/Crusoe sources support the main status/capacity claims; municipal building permits, certificates of occupancy, and utility service/interconnection records were not fully assembled.

actions.result_or_status: Crusoe announced a new 900 MW adjacent Abilene AI factory campus for Microsoft, said land clearing and site preparation were underway, and stated the full Abilene site is expected to reach approximately 2.1 GW total capacity; first new building expected to energize in mid-2027.
actions.access_caveat: Developer announcement; forward-looking portions are projected and should not be treated as current energized capacity.
actions.notes: Capacity source for total projected campus scale, not proof of full buildout.

capacity_notes: Projected full Abilene site capacity from Crusoe's 2026-03-27 announcement: existing Abilene infrastructure plus a new 900 MW adjacent Microsoft campus totals approximately 2.1 GW. Current-live capacity is lower: Crusoe states the first two 100 MW buildings were energized and the second phase to 1.2 GW was expected by end-2026.
owner: Lancium / Abilene DC project entities; Crusoe develops/operates AI factory infrastructure; Oracle and Microsoft are identified customers/tenants in company sources.
